title: Sensient Technologies Corporation Reports Results for the Quarter Ended March 31, 2026
summary: Sensient Technologies Corporation (NYSE: SXT), a leading provider of flavors and colors for the food, pharmaceutical, and personal care markets, today reported financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026. First Quarter Consolidated Results Reported revenue increased 11.1% to $435.8 million in the first quarter of 2026 versus last year’s first quarter results of $392.3 million. On a local currency basis (1) , revenue increased 7.2%. Reported operating income increased 24.7% to $66.7 million compared to $53.5 million recorded in last year’s first quarter. In the first quarter of 2025, the Company recorded $2.9 million of costs related to its Portfolio Optimization Plan versus no costs recorded in the first quarter of 2026. Local currency adjusted operating income (1) and local currency adjusted EBITDA (1) were up 12.2% and 10.4%, respectively, in the first quarter.
